items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: I explained to you Bill... Bill, there's a fellow by the name of Emil Gonzalez... very, it was very shaky, Bill, you see?

ctx.x: Oh, by the way, what about Rag Baby Steelers? Who did he play with mostly?

Well, he played, he played with, with Fishers Band and he played, yeah, imagine he played with Lane and all the early bands. The Harmony Band and, and, and a fella by the name of Cock Eye Hughes. A cornet player had a band. And, and, and, and the Christians had a band. And, and, and, uh. Bronze was a, a favorite band. And these are, like, like, I explained to you Bill, how they call them ragtime military jazz bands. They, they played a little bit of, of everything. If it was a picnic, they'd play jazz. And they…
When you played the dances, they used the snare drum and the bass drum too?
